player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I generated 60 sentences, which violated the strict upper limit of "less than 600 words" (since 60 sentences of average length easily exceed 200 words, and my output was likely over 300 words). I misinterpreted the constraint as a minimum or ignored the word count entirely. Next time, I will draft the expansion first, then count the words precisely. I will aim for a concise narrative of exactly 150 to 200 words, ensuring I stop writing immediately after the word count is reached, even if I have more ideas. I will also ensure the sentence count is at least 60 by making the sentences very short, but I will prioritize the word limit as the primary constraint to avoid failure.
